tasks.title: Conversation #52
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Welcome to the student housing office. What can I do for you?
Man: Hi, I'm looking for a 2 bedroom apartment and I wondered if you have some available?
Woman: Yes we do.
Man: How much is the rent?
Woman: Standard is $1800 a month, but we also have some with a nice view of the lake.Those are 21hundred.
Man: 21 hundred is a bit much. Do you mind if I have a look at one of the standard 2 bedrooms?
Woman: Of course. Let me grab the key from the drawer.

questions.stem: What does the price of a two-bedroom apartment depend on?

options.A: How many people will be living in the apartment
options.B: What kind of view the apartment has
options.C: How long the man is planning to rent the apartment for
options.D: Which floor the apartment is located on

questions.analysis: 答案: B 题目问的是: 两居室公寓的价格取决于什么？属于细节理解题。 定位原文: “We also have some with a nice view of the lake. Those are 21hundred.” 选项分析: A. “How many people will be living in the apartment.”（住在公寓里的人数。）没有提到与价格直接相关的因素，因此A选项错误。 B. “What kind of view the apartment has.”（公寓的视野如何。）根据原文，公寓的价格取决于是否有湖景，因此B选项正确。 C. “How long the man is planning to rent the apartment for.”（租住公寓的时长。）原文并未提到租期对价格的影响，因此C选项错误。 D. “Which floor the apartment is located on.”（公寓所在的楼层。）没有提到楼层与价格的关系，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the woman most likely do next?

options.C: Take the man on a tour of the lake

questions.analysis: 答案: B 题目问的是: 女士接下来最有可能做什么？属于预测题。 定位原文: “Let me grab the key from the drawer.” 选项分析: A. “Ask the man for money.”（向男士要钱。）并没有暗示她会立刻向男士收取租金，因此A选项错误。 B. “Show the man an apartment.”（带男士参观公寓。）原文提到她将去拿钥匙，因此很可能带男士去看公寓，B选项正确。 C. “Take the man on a tour of the lake.”（带男士游览湖区。）与公寓无关，因此C选项错误。 D. “Unlock a drawer.”（打开抽屉。）这是她的一个动作，但并没有明确表明她接下来做的事情，因此D选项错误。
